module: Node "Set License Plate" (`once` behavior). Changes a vehicle's plate text with `core_vehicles.setPlateText(text, vehId)`. Input pins: `flow`, `reset` (pulses), `vehId` (default: player), `text` (string). Output: `flow` (pulse). Runs only once until a `reset`.
notes: An empty text (`''`) changes nothing, but the output flow is still emitted.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Handles `reset`, then, if `ready` and `flow`, applies the text and emits the output flow only once.
